name: Proper Space Warping
definition: A warping function F : R^3 -> R^3 is called a proper warping function if for any two points x1, x2 in a region S visible to a set of cameras {Ci}, the Euclidean distance in warp space equals the sum of squared distances on all visible cameras: ||F(x1) - F(x2)||_2^2 = sum_i ||Ci(x1) - Ci(x2)||_2^2.
